annotations.summary: The service instance is unavailable.
annotations.description: Check the node, its readiness, dependencies, and any recent errors of the selected instance.

annotations.summary: The infrastructure component is unavailable.
annotations.description: Check the component, node, TLS, and request duration. Compare the status of other replicas.

annotations.summary: Node diagnostic collection is unavailable
annotations.description: Check the agent, certificate, port 19443, and the availability of the node.

annotations.summary: Kafka replication is degraded
annotations.description: Check the availability of brokers, ISRs, disks, and network errors.

annotations.summary: Kafka consumer lag is increasing
annotations.description: Compare the input speed, processing speed, data age, and stopped partitions.

annotations.summary: New records are being added to DLQ.
annotations.description: Determine the stage, code, or topic; check the schema and errors of the original service.

annotations.summary: Processing of the partition has been stopped
annotations.description: Check the stage and recurring processing errors.

annotations.summary: Event -> incident commit p99 exceeds 1 s
annotations.description: Compare Kafka lag, Normalizer and Correlation Engine durations, incident transaction duration and PostgreSQL state.

rules.expr: sum by (deployment) (rate(psim_kafka_produced_messages_total{topic="psim.signals.v1"}[2m])) > 0 and on (deployment) sum by (deployment) (increase(psim_incident_signals_persisted_total[2m])) == 0

annotations.summary: Signals are published without recording incidents
annotations.description: Check signal consumer lag, Incident Service and PostgreSQL. Normal event traffic without rule matches does not trigger this alert.

rules.expr: psim_clickhouse_ingest_lag_seconds > 60 and on (deployment, node, service, instance) max by (deployment, node, service, instance) (psim_kafka_consumer_lag) > 0

annotations.summary: ClickHouse loading is lagging
annotations.description: Check pending batches, insertion errors, replication queue, parts and disks. Latest-record age alone does not indicate failure when there is no backlog.

annotations.summary: ClickHouse replication is interrupted
annotations.description: Check Keeper, the availability of the second replica, queue errors, and available space.

annotations.summary: Too many active parts in ClickHouse
annotations.description: Check the table, partition, batch size, and merge speed.

annotations.summary: There is no single primary PostgreSQL
annotations.description: Check Patroni, etcd, watchdog, and the synchronous replication.

annotations.summary: There is no single primary Valkey
annotations.description: Check the Sentinel, availability of the primary, and the status of the replicas.

annotations.summary: Less than 15% of the disk is free
annotations.description: Determine the node and volume. Check the growth of Kafka, ClickHouse, SeaweedFS, and telemetry.

annotations.summary: Less than 5% of the disk is free
annotations.description: Check for backpressure and the presence of acknowledged data. Determine the fastest-growing volume.

annotations.summary: Less than 30 days until the certificate expires
annotations.description: Check the owner and certificate, as well as the chain of trust and CA authority.

annotations.summary: No successful backup available in the last 24 hours
annotations.description: Check the backup, task log, independent target storage, and the last acknowledged completion time.

annotations.summary: The status of the backup copies is unknown.
annotations.description: Check the agent’s state file, its format, permissions, and update it with copying tasks.

annotations.summary: Sites have no current duty assignee
annotations.description: Check tenant, the number of sites without assignments and duty assignments in the console.

annotations.summary: There are disconnected connectors
annotations.description: Compare the number of registrations with active sessions; check the network, certificate expiration, and SDK buffer.

annotations.summary: Node clock skew exceeds 1 s
annotations.description: Check the availability of the time source, chrony, and system clocks. The metric compares the agent’s time with the Prometheus time.

annotations.summary: Correlation recovery exceeds 30 s
annotations.description: Check the state size, changelog lag, disk status, and Kafka availability.

rules.expr: sum by (deployment, service) (rate(psim_api_proxy_failures_total[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (deployment, service) (rate(psim_api_requests_total[5m])), 0.01) > 0.05

annotations.summary: The error rate of API proxying exceeds 5% of incoming requests
annotations.description: Check operation, upstream, TLS, Valkey, and proxy errors.

annotations.summary: The Collector does not deliver telemetry.
annotations.description: Check Loki, Tempo, queues, disks, and Collector errors.

annotations.summary: Failed to obtain detailed metrics
annotations.description: Check the collector, components, monitoring rights, TLS, and protocol compatibility. TCP availability does not guarantee the receipt of metrics.

annotations.summary: No failure notifications are delivered
annotations.description: Check the receiver, TLS, webhook availability, and the Alertmanager log.

annotations.summary: Observability notification channel health
annotations.description: Check for regular receipt of notifications by external monitoring.

annotations.summary: The duration of requests to the dependency exceeds 150 ms
annotations.description: Compare the target with different nodes, check RTT, packet losses, and load.

annotations.summary: The last attempt at backup failed.
annotations.description: Run psimctl diagnose and check the independent storage. Repeat psimctl backup create; do not manually change the time of the last successful backup.

annotations.summary: WAL Archiving Errors in PostgreSQL
annotations.description: Check psimctl backup wal-push, PostgreSQL configuration and the separate backup writer account. Do not delete WAL manually.
